title: Installation Jobs: Casing Legs for Oversize Openings
content:
**Casing legs for oversize openings — Installation Jobs**

Oversize openings need longer casing legs and add to the casing openings when new interior casing is priced on an **Installation Jobs** record. The oversize openings are those recorded above the series' standard size at the latest completed measure of the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract the job installs — the most recent measure visit of that contract with a completed outcome.

| Oversize openings recorded at that measure | Each oversize opening counts as |
|---|---|
| 4 or more | two casing openings (2) |
| 1 to 3 | one and a half casing openings (1.5) |
| none | — every opening counts as one casing opening |

Every other opening on the contract counts as one casing opening. A door job, which installs no window contract, has no oversize opening.

## Worked examples (hypothetical inputs)

| Openings on the contract | Oversize openings at the latest completed measure | Casing openings |
|---|---|---|
| 8 | 0 | 8 |
| 8 | 1 | 7 plus 1.5, that is 8.5 |
| 8 | 3 | 5 plus 4.5, that is 9.5 |
| 8 | 4 | 4 plus 8, that is 12 |
